profile.bio: Seattle weekend hiker, trail-condition note taker, and unapologetic thermos carrier. Usually somewhere between a ferry line and a mossy switchback.

community.name: pnwhiking
community.description: Trail reports, route ideas, conditions, stewardship, and soggy lessons from Washington, Oregon, and British Columbia.

posts.postTitle: The Gorge was running on full PNW mode today
posts.body: Low cloud, wet pavement, and every shade of green. The bridge viewpoint was quiet before breakfast and the rain never quite decided whether it was starting or stopping.

posts.postTitle: Four versions of partly cloudy in one weekend
posts.body: Coast light on Saturday, sunbeams for ten minutes on Sunday, then back into the fog. No summit photo, but the forest absolutely delivered.

profile.bio: Bellingham mountaineer learning to make conservative calls before sunrise. Cascades approaches, snow transitions, rope systems, and strong diner coffee.

community.name: cascades_alpine
community.description: Pacific Northwest mountaineering, scrambling, glacier travel, snow conditions, decision making, and early alpine starts.

posts.postTitle: Shoulder-season recon: snow line, cloud deck, one clear window
posts.body: We treated this as a conditions walk, not a summit bid. Patchy snow started above the lake, visibility moved in and out, and the best decision of the day was keeping the turnaround time boring.

posts.postTitle: Approach views that almost convinced us to skip the summit
posts.body: Sometimes the long approach is the whole trip. Saving this sequence for the next time someone asks why the alarm was set for 2:45 a.m.

profile.bio: Portland climber and Cascades scrambler. Interested in quiet crags, long approaches, careful anchors, and the narrow weather window between damp and wetter.

community.name: pnwclimbing
community.description: Pacific Northwest climbing and scrambling: conditions, approaches, partners, anchors, local ethics, and rain-window optimism.

posts.postTitle: Wet approach, dry rock — the most PNW climbing day possible
posts.body: The trail was a creek and the valley stayed socked in, but the south-facing wall was somehow dry. We climbed three easy pitches and left before the next band arrived.

posts.postTitle: Scouting ridges for next weekend’s scramble
posts.body: No beta dump—just a weather and access look. Water is high, shaded approaches are still slick, and the ridge kept disappearing into cloud every few minutes.
